text_block_list.text:
At last, the first race of the Classic
Triple Crown,
the Satsuki Sho, is here!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан expresses her gratitude to
me for
helping her make it this far, and
then heads out
to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And now, in this race she's always
dreamed of, her
battle against the
skilled Ines Fujin begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
